dottie.name: Dottie Filewell
dottie.about: A clerk who walked out of the Bureau with a cardigan full of files. Keeps the library.

mo.name: Mo Stockley
mo.about: Has sold everything to everyone at least twice. Opens the General store.

bertha.name: Bertha Brew
bertha.about: Hears every rumour first and repeats it louder. Runs the inn.

gus.name: Gus Gasket
gus.about: Fixes anything with a spanner, a hammer or a firm word. Opens the Workshop.

hayden.name: Hayden Bales
hayden.about: Talks to Billies more than to people. Helps at the ranch.

rosa.name: Compass Rosa
rosa.about: Has drawn maps of places that don't exist yet. Works at Skyline Station.

seamus.name: Seamus Stitch
seamus.about: Measures you before saying hello. Sews from a cottage in town.

helix.name: Dr. Helix
helix.about: Reads genes like a menu. Keeps the Gene Bank (the splicing track opens her work).
